comparison.objective: Place four tubes into a bath while keeping their caps above a marked line.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated grasping, orientation control, and constrained placement relative to a liquid-level marker.
comparison.success_condition: All four tubes released into the bath with caps above the line; exact containment and orientation tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Tube placement relative to a bath level does not test fracture mechanics, hammering, insert retention, or small-fragment collection.
